entries.title: Interpreting polar form of a complex number
entries.description: read $Ae^{j\phi}$ as a magnitude-angle representation of a complex quantity.

entries.title: Converting complex numbers between rectangular and polar form
entries.description: rewrite $a+jb$ as $|V|e^{j\angle V}$ by computing magnitude and angle.

entries.title: Adding complex numbers in rectangular form
entries.description: combine phasors by summing their real parts and imaginary parts separately.

entries.title: Using special-angle values in the complex plane
entries.description: recognize values like $e^{j\pi/2}=j$ and standard reference angles in phasor work.

entries.title: Writing a cosine as a complex exponential
entries.description: express $A\cos(\omega t+\phi)$ as the real part of $Ae^{j(\omega t+\phi)}$.
